name: Daniel Cordeiro
tagline: Mechanical engineering student at San Diego State University. Suspension design for Aztec Electric Racing.
about:
Mechanical engineering student at San Diego State University with a passion for all things engineering.

I fell in love with cars in my senior year of high school before really discovering the world of engineering that same year. Those two passions blended into my experience with Aztec Electric Racing (AER) at SDSU.

I was born in São Paulo, Brazil, and moved to California when I was 9 years old. I hold a Green Card and my naturalization process is currently underway.

skills.items: SolidWorks, MATLAB, Ansys Mechanical, Optimum Kinematics, Git, MS Excel, LaTeX
TIG/MIG Welding, Additive Manufacturing (FDM), Manual Milling, Lathing, Water Jetting
